title: FibroX XGBoost model detects advanced fibrosis in MASLD
summary: XGBoost trained on 1,487 NHANES 2017-2020 adults reached AUROC 0.97 versus 0.62 for FIB-4 for advanced fibrosis; in 337 biopsy-confirmed patients it had AUROC 0.84 and outperformed FIB-4. In NHANES III (4,276 participants, up to 30 years) it predicted mortality (C-statistic 0.80). Training labels came from noninvasive screening plus elastography rather than biopsy, so the 0.97 figure is optimistic.
organization: Euclid University; Yale University; VA Connecticut Healthcare System

evidence.tested: External biopsy-confirmed cohort of 337 and NHANES III mortality cohort of 4,276.
evidence.unknown: FIB-4 performance in the biopsy cohort; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Detects advanced fibrosis and prognosticates outcomes
